verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents running the full platform (MongoDB, API, front-end) on your own infrastructure via Docker Compose, and a runtime probe confirms it: the official docker image booted, and a flag was created and evaluated keylessly with no account or license. Community users report running the self-hosted version in production for months; a request for non-Docker hosting and complaints about the MongoDB dependency are limitations, not contradictions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Run GrowthBook on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, including MongoDB, the API, and the front-end.
